description.value: When a soldier makes a melee weapon attack, on a miss, choose a friendly creature within 10 feet. That creature deals 1d6 additional damage with its next melee weapon attack.
When a soldier makes a ranged weapon attack, on a miss, the target suffers the distracted condition (–2 AC, removed after it is hit by an attack) until the end of its next turn.
The wandering duelist makes two attacks. One or more of these attacks can be used for martial techniques.

The wandering duelist adds +3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. It must be wielding a melee weapon and must be able to perceive the attacker. If this causes the attack to miss during a duel, the attacker gains 1 danger die.
The wandering duelist gains 1 focus point at the end of its turn for each attack it made.
The wandering duelist can perform the following martial techniques: 2+ focus points: flashing steel cut, flowing water strike. 3+ focus points: iaijutsu cut: crossing blade.
The sword saint makes five attacks. One or more of these attacks can be used for martial techniques.
At the end of its turn, the sword saint gains 1 focus point for each attack it made and loses a focus point for each time it was hit by an attack since the end of its last turn.

The sword saint can perform the following martial techniques: 1+ focus points: snapping branch strike, soul-sundering strike. 2+ focus points: flashing steel cut, flowing water strike, iaijutsu cut: rising blade, soaring thunderbolt strike. 3+ focus points: iaijutsu cut: crossing blade.
The sword saint's AC is treated as 21 by anyone not currently dueling the sword saint.

The sword saint calls out one creature that can perceive it for a one-on-one duel. That creature must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On success, the creature can choose to accept or reject the duel. On failure, the creature must accept the duel, and begins with 1 danger die.

The sword saint adds +6 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. It must be wielding a melee weapon and must be able to perceive the attacker. If this causes the attack to miss during a duel, the attacker gains 2 danger dice.

The sword saint catches a weapon attack in midair. The attack deals 0 damage. If melee, the attacker must make a DC 17 Strength save or be disarmed. If ranged, the sword saint hurls the projectile back — the attacker must make a DC 17 Dexterity save or suffer the projectile's damage +5. Usable once per short rest or per duel won.
The sword saint plays out the battle mentally, adding 2 danger dice to an opponent they are dueling.

One Small, Medium, or Large creature within 5 feet must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On failure, that creature is knocked prone and immediately moves 5 feet in a direction of the sword saint's choice, unless it chooses to suffer 10 (2d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

One creature within 15 feet must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On failure, that creature becomes frightened of the sword saint, unless it chooses to suffer 10 (2d8 + 2) psychic damage. A creature that fails can repeat this save at the start of each of its turns.
The experienced ritualist has 5 favor, which it can spend to empower its invocations.

Choose one tradition: Spiritual Medium (WIS save DC 14, invocations: commune with spirits, cleansing rite, divine the omens, threshold barrier at will; blade of the elements, caress of earth, mask of wind tier 1; armor of stone, secrets on the wind tier 2; the elements rise tier 3). Elemental Power (INT save DC 14; call of cinders, dance of seasons, path to inner peace tier 1; barricade of earth, fury of Osano-Wō tier 2; wings of the phoenix tier 3). Sacred Creations (CHA save DC 14; armor of stone, blade of the elements, caress of earth tier 1; cloak of night, seal of jade tier 2; realm of illusion tier 3).
On initiative count 20, the experienced ritualist in their inner sanctum immediately regains 1d6 spent favor and heals 3d6 hit points.
On initiative count 20, the experienced ritualist performs the threshold barrier invocation with 5 additional favor to spend on its empowerments.

As a bonus action, the seasoned courtier can force a creature it can perceive to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On failure, the seasoned courtier learns the creature's motivation. On success, the courtier comes to the wrong conclusion, and the creature decides what the courtier incorrectly believes to be its motivation.

When a friendly creature that can perceive the seasoned courtier makes an attack roll against a target the courtier can perceive, the seasoned courtier can spend its reaction to add 1d6 to the attack roll.
The provincial lord makes three attacks.
If encountered on the battlefield, increase its AC to 21 (awakened segmented plate with a +3 bonus). Alternately, use mundane segmented plate (AC 18) and an awakened weapon (+3).
On initiative count 20, the provincial lord calls for reinforcements. Roll 1d4. After that many rounds, three soldiers or one bodyguard (wandering duelist profile) arrive to protect their lord.
On initiative count 20, the provincial lord grabs a hidden weapon and has advantage on the first attack roll made with it.
Hostile creatures within 5 feet have disadvantage on Intimidation and Persuasion checks.
When making a melee attack against a target with 1 or more negative conditions, a ruffian deals an additional 1d4 damage.
The crime boss makes two attacks.
When a crime boss's current hit points are lower than or equal to half its maximum hit points (29 or lower), its AC becomes 15.
The crime boss orders up to 3 friendly ruffians within 30 feet to immediately move 10 feet, then make a melee or ranged attack against one creature in range.

items.name: I'll Show You How It's Done

description.value: One character within 5 feet must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or suffer one of the following conditions until the end of its next turn: distracted (–2 AC, removed after it is hit) or maimed (–10 ft. speed and disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, removed after it regains HP).

items.name: I Have You at a Disadvantage (Recharge 6)

description.value: On initiative count 20, the crime boss calls three additional ruffians to step out from ambush. If the guards have been dispatched, the crime boss cannot use this ability.
On initiative count 20, the crime boss reveals a concealed escape route and immediately moves up to 40 feet toward it.
The first time the wicked sorcerer is targeted by an attack or forced to make a saving throw each round, its AC is 18 or it makes that saving throw with advantage.

When the wicked sorcerer inflicts a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, it immediately regains the use of one expended spell. If it kills the creature with the critical hit, it regains all expended spells instead.
Spellcasting ability: Wisdom (spell save DC 15). At will: darkness, eldritch blast, sending. 1/day: arcane hand, arcane sword, hellish rebuke, shatter.
Spellcasting ability: Charisma (spell save DC 15). At will: disguise self, invisibility, minor illusion. 1/day each: blur, dream, fear, hypnotic pattern.
Spellcasting ability: Intelligence (spell save DC 15). At will: bestow curse, mark of desecration, speak with dead. 1/day each: contagion, inflict wounds, ray of enfeeblement, vampiric touch.
One creature within 10 feet must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On failure, it takes 2d6 necrotic damage and is pushed 20 feet away in a direction of the sorcerer's choice.
The wicked sorcerer unleashes a spell that it can cast at will.
The wicked sorcerer makes one melee attack with its obsidian dagger with advantage on the attack roll.
On initiative count 20, three ruffians from the cult step forth to fight.
On initiative count 20, the wicked sorcerer springs a trap on one creature it can perceive within its den. This has the effect of the hold person spell.

value: piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks

description.value: When the undying warrior hits with a ranged weapon attack, the creature it hit must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On failure, the creature takes 1d4 additional poison damage and suffers the maimed condition (–10 ft. speed and disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, removed after it regains HP).
Any Medium humanoid creature that is killed within 10 feet of this creature rises as an undying warrior one minute later. Nezumi are unaffected.

value: piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks

description.value: Any Medium humanoid creature killed within 10 feet rises as an undying warrior one minute later. Nezumi are unaffected.

Breath Weapon (Recharge 5–6): The demonwind steed unleashes baleful energies in a 20-foot cone. Each creature must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (4d8) necrotic damage on failure, or half on success.

value: piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks

description.value: The horrific brute makes one bite attack and one claw attack, or two claw attacks.

At the start of its turn, if the horrific brute's current hit points are lower than or equal to half its maximum hit points (41), it gains 1 additional Shadowlands Power. It loses that power at the end of the encounter. It cannot use this ability again until it completes a long rest.
Each creature within 40 feet must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On failure, a creature suffers 5 (1d8 + 1) thunder damage, is deafened until the end of its next turn, and is knocked prone.
The horrific brute makes one bite attack and one claw attack, or two claw attacks.
The lesser horror makes one claw attack and one bite attack.

value: piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks

description.value: The lord of dread makes two claw attacks and one bite attack, or three claw attacks.

At the start of its turn, if the lord of dread's current hit points are lower than or equal to half its maximum hit points (128), it gains 2 additional Shadowlands Powers. It loses those powers at the end of the encounter. Cannot use again until after a long rest.

Each creature in a 30-foot sphere must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the lord of dread, unless it chooses to suffer 3d6 psychic damage. A creature that fails can repeat this save at the start of each of its turns.

The lord of dread makes a multitarget attack roll against each creature in a 15-foot sweep around it. On a hit, a creature suffers 18 (3d6+7) slashing damage and the bleeding condition (1d4 piercing damage at the start of each of its turns, removed after it regains HP) for one minute.

The hostile creature with the highest hit points within 90 feet must make a DC 20 Charisma saving throw. On failure, it suffers 12 (2d12) psychic damage and is marked for death (the next successful melee attack the lord of dread makes against it deals an additional 1d8 force damage) for one minute or until the lord of dread deals damage to it.
The troll performs one attack with its fists and one attack with a hurled boulder or tree, or two attacks with its fists.
Spellcasting ability: Wisdom (spell save DC 21). 1/day each: enhance ability, identify, legend lore.
Spellcasting ability: Wisdom (spell save DC 19). 1/day each: conjure animals, locate person, revivify.

The manifest air spirit can perform any air invocation. Its invocation ability modifier is Dexterity, and its invocation save DC is 16. When it performs an air invocation, it gains 3 additional favor to spend on its empowerments. Any favor not spent this way is lost.

value: piercing and slashing from nonmagical sources

description.value: The manifest earth spirit can perform any earth invocation. Its invocation ability modifier is Constitution, and its invocation save DC is 16. When it performs an earth invocation, it gains 3 additional favor to spend on its empowerments. Any favor not spent this way is lost.

value: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical sources

description.value: The manifest fire spirit can perform any fire invocation. Its invocation ability modifier is Intelligence, and its invocation save DC is 16. When it performs a fire invocation, it gains 3 additional favor to spend on its empowerments. Any favor not spent this way is lost.

value: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical sources

description.value: The manifest water spirit can perform any water invocation. Its invocation ability modifier is Strength, and its invocation save DC is 16. When it performs a water invocation, it gains 3 additional favor to spend on its empowerments. Any favor not spent this way is lost.

If a shikigami is invested with one or more invocations of a particular element, it gains bonuses based on the element: Air gains DEX (2× highest rank), Earth gains HP (5× highest rank), Fire gains INT (2× highest rank), Water gains CHA (2× highest rank).

On its turn, a shikigami's creator can spend a bonus action and favor up to their Intelligence modifier to have the shikigami perform one of its sealed invocations with that much additional favor to spend. Unspent favor is lost.

value: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical sources

description.value: On the first round of combat or for the duration of the round in which the spectral trooper is first summoned, it gains a +2 bonus to its AC.

When the spectral trooper is reduced to 0 hit points, it can make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On success, at the start of the next round, it regains 1 hit point. On failure, its body and equipment vanish in shining motes that rise to the stars.
When its rider is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, the Utaku steed can spend its reaction to have its rider drop to 1 hit point instead.

If the Utaku steed moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the horse can make another attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

value: piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks

description.value: The Lost champion makes three attacks.
When another Lost creature starts its turn within 10 feet of one or more lost champions, it increases its movement speed by 10 feet until the end of its turn.

The first time damage would reduce a lost champion to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead, then regains hit points equal to 1d12 + its Constitution modifier, and gains one Shadowlands power. Each time it kills a living creature, a lost champion regains the use of this ability.
Any Medium humanoid creature killed within 10 feet rises as an undying warrior one minute later. Nezumi are unaffected.
